body: Guillemard East is the shortlist when denser central-east living and stadium-adjacent energy matter more than quiet heartland weekends. Expats land here for car-light hops to CBD / Bugis and ActiveSG catchment without Orchard premiums. Compare with Kembangan Fringe for quieter EWL living, Bedok North West for heartland value, and Paya Lebar West when interchange office-edge wins.
